name: Mountain Pass Cargo Run

tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 6
tasks.content: Have Goat take off to 23.1 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (167.3, 446.3), the south-east corner (558.7, 415.2), the north-east corner (671.9, 240.1) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 23.1 meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
